lesson.meaning: To show something clearly, or to put something where it can be easily seen.
examples: Please display your ID card clearly when you enter the office.
The project manager asked me to display the quarterly report on the big screen during our meeting.
Many companies like to display their awards in the reception area to show their achievements.
Our new website needs to display the product information more effectively for customers.
She always tries to display a calm and confident demeanor, even under pressure.
lesson.memory_tip: Think of 'display' as making something visible, like putting a painting 'on show' for everyone to see!
